messages:
Eli: hey all, eli here 00 first week. my PR CI is failing on the image publish step with `denied` from GHCR. i'm confused because the same repo uses a GH Actions workflow that "passes" but Buildkite is failing. who owns the CI creds?

Buildkite Bot: build #7 failed: step `publish-image` (exit 1)
```
> Pushing to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/eli-test:pr-9
> denied: requested access to the resource is denied
> error: failed to push some refs to 'ghcr.io/redwood-inference/eli-test'
```

Eli: my Buildkite pipeline env has GHCR_PAT set to a token i created during signup. i toggled the workflow secret to the same value too.

Rox: welcome! :wave: quick explanation: GHA run that "passes" might be using the repo's GITHUB_TOKEN or an org-installed GitHub App which has package write, whereas your Buildkite PAT probably lacks `packages` scope. also GITHUB_TOKEN in GH Actions often can't push to GHCR unless repo settings allow it.

Infra: adding detail: we have two allowed patterns here: (1) org GitHub App installed with `packages: write` for managed pipelines, or (2) a PAT with `write:packages` + `read:packages` stored in Buildkite. MFA enforcement can block some PATs if generated without org SSO—if your account is org-managed you need to authorize the PAT via SSO.

Eli: ah that might be it. i see a SSO prompt when i try to use the token locally. is there a simple local command to check scope before re-running the build?

Rox: yep run locally:
```
echo "$CANDIDATE_PAT" | docker login ghcr.io -u <your-github-username> --password-stdin
docker push ghcr.io/redwood-inference/eli-test:canary
```
if you get `denied` you need `write:packages` or SSO approval. also `gh auth status` and `gh api /user` can show token scopes.

Eli: ran the login test and got `denied`. i regenerated a PAT with `read:packages, write:packages` and completed the org SSO approval flow. updated GHCR_PAT in Buildkite.

Buildkite Bot: build #8 started - step `publish-image`

Buildkite Bot: build #8 succeeded 02 - image pushed to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/eli-test:pr-9

Eli: all good now, thanks. noted in my onboarding doc: watch for org SSO + packages scope. @Rox @Vera can we do a 10-min walkthrough on the org app vs PAT tradeoffs later?

Vera: yup happy to. quick note: we prefer org app for long-term repos, PATs only for temporary sandboxes. ping me and i'll show the install flow. :thumbsup:
